title: Update actions/setup-go action to v7.1.0
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| [actions/setup-go](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go) | action | minor | `v7.0.0` → `v7.1.0` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>actions/setup-go</summary>

### [`v7.1.0`](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/releases/tag/v7.1.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/compare/v7.0.0...v7.1.0)

##### What's Changed

##### Enhancements

- Expose go env variables as action outputs by [@​v-mahabaleshwars](https://redirect.github.com/v-mahabaleshwars) in [#​791](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/791)
- Preserve native Go environment names in action outputs by [@​v-mahabaleshwars](https://redirect.github.com/v-mahabaleshwars) in [#​793](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/793)
- Add support for native Go version syntax in go-version input by [@​v-jitenderpalsingh](https://redirect.github.com/v-jitenderpalsingh) in [#​804](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/804)
- Add support for rc and beta versions in go.mod file by [@​arnested](https://redirect.github.com/arnested) in [#​701](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/701)
- Clarify description of go-bin-path output and its fallback behavior by [@​v-mahabaleshwars](https://redirect.github.com/v-mahabaleshwars) in [#​803](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/803)
- Group verbose Go installation logs and normalize package.json line endings by [@​v-priyagupta108](https://redirect.github.com/v-priyagupta108) in [#​789](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/789)

##### Dependency updates

- Bump js-yaml from 3.15.1 to 3.15.2 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​790](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/790)
- Bump [@​actions/cache](https://redirect.github.com/actions/cache) to 6.3.0 by [@​qmuntal](https://redirect.github.com/qmuntal) in [#​794](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/794)
- Bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​802](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/802)
- Bump nock from 14.0.15 to 14.0.17 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​767](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/767)
- Bump [@​typescript-eslint/parser](https://redirect.github.com/typescript-eslint/parser) from 8.62.0 to 8.72.1 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​777](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/777)
- Bump undici from 6.28.0 to 6.29.1 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​807](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/807)
- Bump eslint-plugin-jest from 29.15.2 to 29.17.0 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​776](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/issues/776)  
- Bump [@​typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin](https://redirect.github.com/typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin) from 8.62.0 to 8.72.1 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​778](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/778)
- Bump prettier from 3.8.4 to 3.9.10 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot) in [#​775](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/775)
- Bump package version to 7.1.0 by [@​v-priyagupta108](https://redirect.github.com/v-priyagupta108) in [#​818](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/818)
- fix: resolve audit/license failures by [@​v-HarithaVattikuti](https://redirect.github.com/v-HarithaVattikuti) in [#​784](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/784)
- Upgrade checkout refs and docs to v7 by [@​v-HarithaVattikuti](https://redirect.github.com/v-HarithaVattikuti) in [#​779](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/779)
- fix: update macOS runner configuration to use macOS 15 Intel by [@​v-priya-kinthali](https://redirect.github.com/v-priya-kinthali) in [#​786](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/786)

##### New Contributors

- [@​qmuntal](https://redirect.github.com/qmuntal) made their first contribution in [#​794](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/794)
- [@​v-jitenderpalsingh](https://redirect.github.com/v-jitenderpalsingh) made their first contribution in [#​804](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/804)
- [@​arnested](https://redirect.github.com/arnested) made their first contribution in [#​701](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-go/pull/701)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/actions/setup-go/compare/v7.0.0...v7.1.0>

</details>
